Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was driving home on a weekday afternoon when the car in front of me stopped suddenly, and I braked as hard as I
could. The vehicle coming the other way drifted over the center line and struck the front of my car. Neither of us was
moving fast, but the impact pushed my head forward and then back against the headrest. Within a few hours I had
stiffness and a dull ache across my neck and lower back, and I have been sore since. I have given the same
description of what happened to the adjuster, to the police officer at the scene, and to my doctor, and I have nothing
to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating my own vehicle at the time. I am asking
that this claim be reviewed so that my medical treatment and vehicle repairs can be covered.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
